Видеорегистратор ViON: постоянная запись: The ViON video recorder: continuous and event recording, the archive on a timeline, events and export. Runs entirely on your own server, without external accounts.
Лимиты записи задаёт тариф ViON Cloud вл: The recording limits are set by the ViON Cloud plan of the server owner. To change the plan: cloud.vionvision.tech → "Plan".
Видео и события старше этого срока удаля: Video and events older than this are deleted automatically. Favorite events stay in the list, but their video is deleted too. Not longer than the plan allows.
0 — без лимита (архив ограничен только с: 0 means no limit (the archive is limited only by the free space on the disk).
Когда свободного места меньше, самые ста: When less space is free, the oldest recordings are deleted.
Режим «по событию»: сколько секунд писат: "On event" mode: how many seconds to keep recording after the motion has ended.
Архив хранится файлами такой длины; коро: The archive is stored in files of this length; shorter files are deleted more precisely, longer ones mean fewer files.
Звук с камер сохраняется в архиве и слыш: Sound from the cameras is saved in the archive and can be heard during playback and in exported video. Works only if the camera delivers sound (it must be turned on in the settings of the camera itself). Recording with sound runs through ffmpeg, which converts any sound to AAC. Recording sound is regulated by law: inform the people it concerns.
После каждого события с человеком, транс: After every event with a person, vehicle or animal, the assistant model describes what happened ("a courier left a parcel at the door"). The descriptions are shown in the recordings and can be found with "AI Search". Needs a model that understands pictures (Settings → Assistant) and permission for ViON NVR.
Отправлять описание события уведомлением: Send the event description as a notification ("Courier left a parcel"). To avoid getting two notifications, turn off the regular detection notifications of these cameras.
Ограничение расхода модели: события свер: Limits how much the model is used: events above the limit get no description. 0 means no limit.
Модель ассистента, которой пользуется NV: The assistant model the NVR uses. It is chosen in Settings → Assistant.
